```{r startup, include = F}
## Set chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  cache.extra = tools::md5sum(here::here("Data", "Clean Data.rds")) # Some chunks cache objects; reset them if Clean Data.rds changes
)

## Set seed
set.seed(57135)


## Load packages
library(here)
library(lordif)
library(rms)
library(mirt)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(broom)
library(scales)
library(survey)
library(tidyverse)
`%+%` <- paste0

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = T)


## Load data
df <- readRDS(here("Data", "Clean Data.rds"))


## Set global variables
phq_items <- "phq_" %+% 1:9

groups <- c("HMS", "NHANES")

item_labels <- c(
  phq_1 = "1. Anhedonia",
  phq_2 = "2. Depressed mood",
  phq_3 = "3. Sleep",
  phq_4 = "4. Fatigue",
  phq_5 = "5. Appetite",
  phq_6 = "6. Feeling bad about self",
  phq_7 = "7. Concentration",
  phq_8 = "8. Psychomotor",
  phq_9 = "9. Suicidal ideation"
)

item_labels_table <- set_names(str_remove(item_labels, "\\."), names(item_labels))
 
response_labels <- c(
  "0" = "Not at all",
  "1" = "Several days",
  "2" = "More than half the days",
  "3" = "Nearly every day"
)

theta_limits <- c(-3, 5) # For plots; covers nearly all of both groups (HMS mean ~1, SD ~0.9)


## Set visual style
sample_colors <- c("NHANES" = "#0072B2", "HMS" = "#D55E00")

response_colors <- c("#a9c9ef", "#5d9ae3", "#2a78d6", "#0b3f80") # Light to dark blue: "not at all" to "nearly every day"


## Set scheme labels (used in all cross-scheme tables and figures)
scheme_labels <- c(
  inv = "No Anchors (All Other Items Constrained)",
  emp = "Empirical Anchors (4, 5)",
  the = "Theory-Driven Anchors (1, 2)"
)

scheme_colors <- set_names(c("#1B2430", "#1baf7a", "#6250d6"), scheme_labels)
 
theme_style <- function(base_size = 9) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0),
      panel.spacing = unit(10, "pt")
    )
}


## Set helper functions
# Format a data frame as an HTML table (missing values print as blank)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

format_table <- function(x, caption, digits = 2, ...) {
  x %>%
    kable(caption = caption, digits = digits, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), ...) %>%
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "hover"),
      full_width = F,
      position = "left"
    )
}

# Format p-values for tables
format_p <- function(p) if_else(p < .001, "< .001", sprintf("%.3f", p))

# Item parameters (slope a1, intercepts d1-d3) side by side for each group
item_parameter_table <- function(model, caption) {
  coef(model, simplify = T) %>%
    map(~ as_tibble(.x$items, rownames = "item")) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "group") %>%
    mutate(item = item_labels_table[item]) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = c(a1, d1, d2, d3), names_glue = "{group}_{.value}") %>%
    select(item, starts_with("NHANES"), starts_with("HMS")) %>%
    format_table(caption, col.names = c("Item", rep(c("a", "d1", "d2", "d3"), 2))) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "NHANES" = 4, "HMS" = 4))
}

# DIF tests (uniform, non-uniform, omnibus) side by side; each test a data frame with item, X2, df, p
dif_test_table <- function(tests, caption) {
  tests %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "test") %>%
    group_by(item) %>%
    mutate(anchor = any(df == 0)) %>% # Anchor items are not tested
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(X2, df), ~ if_else(anchor, NA_real_, .x)),
      p = if_else(anchor, NA_character_, format_p(p)),
      item = item_labels_table[item],
      test = factor(test, levels = names(tests))
    ) %>%
    select(-anchor) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = test, values_from = c(X2, df, p), names_glue = "{test}_{.value}") %>%
    select(item, all_of(as.vector(t(outer(names(tests), c("X2", "df", "p"), paste, sep = "_"))))) %>%
    format_table(caption, digits = 1, col.names = c("Item", rep(c("χ²", "df", "p"), 3))) %>%
    add_header_above(c(" " = 1, set_names(rep(3, 3), names(tests))))
}

# Meade (2010) item-level effect sizes
effect_size_table <- function(effect_sizes, caption) {
  effect_sizes %>%
    transmute(
      Item = item_labels_table[item],
      SIDS, UIDS, ESSD,
      `Max difference` = max.D,
      `Theta at max` = theta.of.max.D
    ) %>%
    format_table(caption)
}

save_figure <- function(plot, name, height, width = 7) {
  ggsave(
    filename = here("Figure - " %+% name %+% ".png"),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = 600,
    bg = "white"
  )
}
```

# Sample description

```{r sample-description}
## Sample sizes
sample_n <- df %>%
  count(sample_fct) %>%
  mutate(label = sample_fct %+% " (n = " %+% comma(n) %+% ")")

sample_n %>%
  select(Sample = sample_fct, n) %>%
  format_table("Analytic sample sizes")
 

## Sum score distribution
sum_score_dist <- df %>%
  count(sample_fct, phq_sum) %>%
  group_by(sample_fct) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()


## Sample labels and their positions on the distribution plot
sum_score_labels <- tibble(
  sample_fct = factor(c("NHANES", "HMS"), levels = c("NHANES", "HMS")),
  phq_sum = c(1.6, 7.6),
  prop = c(.2, .085)
) %>%
  left_join(select(sample_n, sample_fct, label), by = "sample_fct")


## Distribution plot
phq_distribution_plot <- sum_score_dist %>%
  ggplot(aes(phq_sum, prop, color = sample_fct)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 10, xmax = 27, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "#F0F0F0"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 10.2, y = .32, label = "Positive screen (≥ 10)",
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 9 / .pt,
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .6) +
  geom_point(size = .9) +
  geom_text(
    data = sum_score_labels,
    aes(label = label),
    hjust = 0, size = 8.5 / .pt
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = sample_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "PHQ-9 sum score",
    breaks = seq(0, 27, 3),
    expand = expansion(add = c(.5, .5))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Share of respondents",
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, .33),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(title = "PHQ-9 Sum Score Distribution by Sample") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

phq_distribution_plot
 
save_figure(phq_distribution_plot, "PHQ Distribution by Group", height = 3.4)
 

## Item response distributions
item_dist <- df %>%
  select(sample_fct, all_of(phq_items)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(phq_items),
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  ) %>%
  count(sample_fct, item, response) %>%
  group_by(sample_fct, item) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    item = factor(item_labels[item], levels = rev(item_labels)), # So that item 1 is at the top
    response = factor(response, levels = 3:0, labels = rev(response_labels)) # So that "not at all" is on the left
  )

# Ratio of endorsement rates (item >= 1), HMS / NHANES, printed to the right of the HMS panel
endorsement_ratio <- df %>%
  group_by(sample_fct) %>%
  summarize(across(all_of(phq_items), ~ mean(.x >= 1))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(phq_items), names_to = "item", values_to = "p_endorsed") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_fct, values_from = p_endorsed) %>%
  transmute(
    sample_fct = factor("HMS", levels = c("NHANES", "HMS")),
    item = factor(item_labels[item], levels = rev(item_labels)),
    label = "× " %+% sprintf("%.1f", HMS / NHANES)
  )

item_response_plot <- item_dist %>%
  ggplot(aes(prop, item, fill = response)) +
  geom_col(width = .75, colour = "white", linewidth = .25) +
  geom_text(
    data = endorsement_ratio,
    aes(x = 1.06, y = item, label = label),
    inherit.aes = F,
    hjust = 0, size = 8 / .pt
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = tibble(sample_fct = factor("HMS", levels = c("NHANES", "HMS"))),
    aes(x = 1.06, y = length(item_labels) + .6, label = "P(Endorsed)\nHMS ÷ NHANES"),
    inherit.aes = F,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0, lineheight = .9, size = 7.5 / .pt, color = "grey35"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ sample_fct,
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = as_labeller(setNames(sample_n$label, sample_n$sample_fct))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = setNames(response_colors, response_labels),
    breaks = unname(response_labels)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Share of respondents",
    labels = percent,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, .01))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Item Response Distributions by Sample") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.key.size = unit(8, "pt"),
    strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
    axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(28, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 62, 5.5, 5.5) # Room for the ratio column
  )

item_response_plot
 
save_figure(item_response_plot, "Item Response Distributions by Group", height = 5)
```

# Primary IRT Model: No Anchors

```{r primary-irt-model, cache = T}
## Fit multiple-group IRT model with mirt
model_inv <- multipleGroup(
  data = df[, phq_items], # PHQ items only
  model = 1, # One-factor model
  group = df$sample_fct, # Grouped by sample
  itemtype = "graded", # i.e., polytomous
  invariance = c(
    phq_items, # Hold invariant parameters (slopes, intercepts) for all items
    "free_means", # Allow non-reference group (i.e., HMS) mean to vary
    "free_var" # Allow non-reference group (i.e., HMS) variance to vary
  ),
  verbose = F
)

item_parameter_table(model_inv, "Item parameters: " %+% scheme_labels[["inv"]] %+% " (all items equal across groups)")


## Test DIF with mirt
# A test of uniform DIF (free intercepts)
uniform_test_inv <- DIF(
  MGmodel = model_inv, # Use multi-group model above
  which.par = c("d1", "d2", "d3"), # Free intercepts relative to a fully constrained model in order to test uniform DIF
  scheme = "drop", # Specify that parameters in which.par will be freely estimated
  p.adjust = "none"
)

# A test of omnibus DIF (free intercepts and slopes)
omnibus_test_inv <- DIF(
  MGmodel = model_inv, # Use multi-group model above
  which.par = c("a1", "d1", "d2", "d3"), # Free intercepts and slopes relative to a fully constrained model to test omnibus DIF
  scheme = "drop", # Specify that parameters in which.par will be freely estimated 
  p.adjust = "none"
)

# A test of non-uniform DIF (omnibus - uniform)
nonuniform_test_inv <- left_join(
  omnibus_test_inv %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2_omnibus = X2),
  uniform_test_inv %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2_uniform = X2),
  by = "item"
) %>%
  mutate(
    X2_difference = X2_omnibus - X2_uniform,
    p = pchisq(X2_difference, df = 1, lower.tail = F)
  )

dif_test_table(
  list(
    Uniform = uniform_test_inv %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2, df, p),
    `Non-uniform` = nonuniform_test_inv %>% transmute(item, X2 = X2_difference, df = 1, p),
    Omnibus = omnibus_test_inv %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2, df, p)
  ),
  "DIF tests: " %+% scheme_labels[["inv"]]
)


## Release each item one at a time (to estimate effect sizes of each item's DIF, below)
released_models <- map(
  .x = 1:9,
  .f = ~ {
    
    # Fit a model with that item's parameters free
    model_free_.x <- multipleGroup(
      df[, phq_items],
      model = 1,
      group = df$sample_fct,
      itemtype = "graded",
      invariance = c(
        phq_items[-.x], # Free parameters of variable .x
        "free_means",
        "free_var"
      ),
      verbose = F
    )
    
    return(model_free_.x)
    
  }
)


## Use released models to estimate effect sizes of each item's DIF
effect_sizes_inv <- map2(
  .x = released_models,
  .y = 1:9,
  .f = ~ empirical_ES(mod = .x, focal_items = .y) %>%
    rownames_to_column("item")
) %>%
  bind_rows()

effect_size_table(effect_sizes_inv, "DIF effect sizes: " %+% scheme_labels[["inv"]])
# SIDS: Signed item difference in the sample (i.e., across HMS respondents); 
#       the average expected (model-implied) difference between HMS and NHANES 
#       item responses at a given theta, across the theta distribution of HMS
# UIDS: Unsigned item difference in the sample; above, but average absolute value
#       at every theta
# ESSD: Expected score standardized difference; SIDS but adjusted for SD of 
#       expected scores (as low-frequency, low-SD items otherwise produce lower 
#       differences)


## Build tibble of expected values (and probabilities of each response level) given group, item, theta
item_group_combinations <- expand_grid(
  item = 1:9,
  group = groups
)

expected_values_inv <- map2(
  .x = item_group_combinations$item,
  .y = item_group_combinations$group,
  .f = ~ {
    
    model_.x <- released_models[[.x]]
    
    item_.x_.y <- extract.item(extract.group(model_.x, .y), .x) # Group first: works across mirt versions

    expected_values_.x_.y <- tibble(theta = seq(-5, 5, .01)) %>%
      mutate(
        item = .x,
        group = .y,
        ev = expected.item(item_.x_.y, theta),
        p1 = probtrace(item_.x_.y, theta)[, "P.1"],
        p2 = probtrace(item_.x_.y, theta)[, "P.2"],
        p3 = probtrace(item_.x_.y, theta)[, "P.3"],
        p4 = probtrace(item_.x_.y, theta)[, "P.4"]
      )
    
    return(expected_values_.x_.y)
    
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

## Figures for Primary IRT Model

```{r irt-figures}
## Prepare curve data for plotting
curves_inv <- expected_values_inv %>%
  filter(between(theta, theta_limits[1], theta_limits[2])) %>%
  mutate(
    item = factor(item_labels[phq_items[item]], levels = item_labels),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NHANES", "HMS"))
  )
 
 
## Item score functions: expected item score by theta and group
# Signed difference (SIDS) printed in each panel
sids_labels_inv <- effect_sizes_inv %>%
  transmute(
    item = factor(item_labels[item], levels = item_labels),
    label = "SIDS = " %+% sprintf("%+.2f", SIDS)
  )

item_score_plot_inv <- curves_inv %>%
  ggplot(aes(theta, ev, color = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .6) +
  geom_text(
    data = sids_labels_inv,
    aes(x = theta_limits[1], y = 3, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 7.5 / .pt, color = "grey35"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ item, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = expression("Depression (" * theta * ", NHANES SD units)"),
    limits = theta_limits,
    breaks = theta_limits[1]:theta_limits[2]
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Expected item score",
    limits = c(0, 3),
    breaks = 0:3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Expected Item Score by Group: " %+% scheme_labels[["inv"]]) +
  theme_style()

item_score_plot_inv

save_figure(item_score_plot_inv, "Item Score Functions by Group", height = 6)


## Category response curves: probability of each response option by theta and group
category_curves_inv <- curves_inv %>%
  select(theta, item, group, p1:p4) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = p1:p4,
    names_to = "response",
    values_to = "prob"
  ) %>%
  mutate(response = factor(response, levels = c("p1", "p2", "p3", "p4"), labels = 0:3))
 
# Label each category (0-3) above its highest curve, first panel only
category_labels_inv <- category_curves_inv %>%
  filter(item == item_labels[1]) %>%
  group_by(response) %>%
  slice_max(prob, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    theta = case_when(
      response == "0" ~ theta_limits[1] + .3, # Category 0 peaks at the left edge
      response == "3" ~ theta_limits[2] - .3, # Category 3 peaks at the right edge
      TRUE ~ theta
    ),
    prob = case_when(
      response %in% c("0", "3") ~ .92,
      TRUE ~ prob + .07
    )
  )
 
category_curve_plot_inv <- category_curves_inv %>%
  ggplot(aes(theta, prob, color = group, group = interaction(group, response))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .5) +
  geom_text(
    data = category_labels_inv,
    aes(label = response),
    color = "grey35", size = 7.5 / .pt,
    show.legend = F
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ item, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = expression("Depression (" * theta * ", NHANES SD units)"),
    limits = theta_limits,
    breaks = theta_limits[1]:theta_limits[2]
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Probability of response",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, .25),
    labels = percent
  ) +
  labs(title = "Category Response Curves by Group: " %+% scheme_labels[["inv"]]) +
  theme_style()
 
category_curve_plot_inv

save_figure(category_curve_plot_inv, "Category Response Curves by Group", height = 6)
```

# Alternative IRT Model 1: Empirical Anchors (Items 4, 5)

```{r empirical-anchor-model, cache = T}
## Fit model with empirical anchors
model_emp <- multipleGroup(
  data = df[, phq_items], # PHQ items only
  model = 1, # One-factor model
  group = df$sample_fct, # Grouped by sample
  itemtype = "graded", # i.e., polytomous
  invariance = c(
    c("phq_4", "phq_5"), # Hold invariant parameters (slopes, intercepts) for anchor items
    "free_means", # Allow non-reference group (i.e., HMS) mean to vary
    "free_var" # Allow non-reference group (i.e., HMS) variance to vary
  ),
  verbose = F
)

item_parameter_table(model_emp, "Item parameters: " %+% scheme_labels[["emp"]])


## Test DIF with mirt
# A test of non-uniform DIF
nonuniform_test_emp <- DIF(
  MGmodel = model_emp, # Use multi-group model above
  which.par = "a1", # Constrain slopes relative to a fully free model to test non-uniform DIF
  scheme = "add", # Specify that parameters in which.par will be constrained
  p.adjust = "none"
)

# A test of omnibus DIF
omnibus_test_emp <- DIF(
  MGmodel = model_emp, # Use multi-group model above
  which.par = c("a1", "d1", "d2", "d3"), # Constrain intercepts and slopes relative to a fully free model to test omnibus DIF
  scheme = "add", # Specify that parameters in which.par will be constrained
  p.adjust = "none"
)

# A test of uniform DIF (omnibus - non-uniform)
uniform_test_emp <- left_join(
  omnibus_test_emp %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2_omnibus = X2),
  nonuniform_test_emp %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2_nonuniform = X2),
  by = "item"
) %>%
  mutate(
    X2_difference = X2_omnibus - X2_nonuniform,
    p = pchisq(X2_difference, df = 3, lower.tail = F)
  )

dif_test_table(
  list(
    Uniform = uniform_test_emp %>% transmute(item, X2 = X2_difference, df = 3, p),
    `Non-uniform` = nonuniform_test_emp %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2, df, p),
    Omnibus = omnibus_test_emp %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2, df, p)
  ),
  "DIF tests: " %+% scheme_labels[["emp"]] %+% " (anchor items show no test)"
)


## Estimate effect sizes of each (non-anchor) item's DIF
effect_sizes_emp <- empirical_ES(model_emp, focal_items = 1:9) %>%
  rownames_to_column("item")

effect_size_table(effect_sizes_emp, "DIF effect sizes: " %+% scheme_labels[["emp"]])


## Build tibble of expected values given group, item, theta
expected_values_emp <- map2(
  .x = item_group_combinations$item,
  .y = item_group_combinations$group,
  .f = ~ {
    
    item_.x_.y <- extract.item(extract.group(model_emp, .y), .x) # Group first: works across mirt versions

    expected_values_.x_.y <- tibble(theta = seq(-5, 5, .01)) %>%
      mutate(
        item = .x,
        group = .y,
        ev = expected.item(item_.x_.y, theta)
      )
    
    return(expected_values_.x_.y)
    
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

## Figures for Alternative IRT Model 1

```{r irt-figures-alt-1}
## Prepare curve data for plotting
curves_emp <- expected_values_emp %>%
  filter(between(theta, theta_limits[1], theta_limits[2])) %>%
  mutate(
    item = factor(item_labels[phq_items[item]], levels = item_labels),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NHANES", "HMS"))
  )
 
 
## Item score functions: expected item score by theta and group
# Signed difference (SIDS) printed in each panel; anchor items labeled as such
sids_labels_emp <- effect_sizes_emp %>%
  transmute(
    label = if_else(item %in% c("phq_4", "phq_5"), "Anchor Item", "SIDS = " %+% sprintf("%+.2f", SIDS)),
    item = factor(item_labels[item], levels = item_labels)
  )

item_score_plot_emp <- curves_emp %>%
  ggplot(aes(theta, ev, color = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .6) +
  geom_text(
    data = sids_labels_emp,
    aes(x = theta_limits[1], y = 3, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 7.5 / .pt, color = "grey35"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ item, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = expression("Depression (" * theta * ", NHANES SD units)"),
    limits = theta_limits,
    breaks = theta_limits[1]:theta_limits[2]
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Expected item score",
    limits = c(0, 3),
    breaks = 0:3
  ) +
  labs(title = "Expected Item Score by Group: " %+% scheme_labels[["emp"]]) +
  theme_style()

item_score_plot_emp

save_figure(item_score_plot_emp, "Item Score Functions by Group (Empirical Anchors)", height = 6)
```

# Alternative IRT Model 2: Theory-Driven Anchors (Items 1, 2)

```{r theory-driven-anchor-model, cache = T}
## Fit model with theory-driven anchors
model_the <- multipleGroup(
  data = df[, phq_items], # PHQ items only
  model = 1, # One-factor model
  group = df$sample_fct, # Grouped by sample
  itemtype = "graded", # i.e., polytomous
  invariance = c(
    c("phq_1", "phq_2"), # Hold invariant parameters (slopes, intercepts) for anchor items
    "free_means", # Allow non-reference group (i.e., HMS) mean to vary
    "free_var" # Allow non-reference group (i.e., HMS) variance to vary
  ),
  verbose = F
)

item_parameter_table(model_the, "Item parameters: " %+% scheme_labels[["the"]])


## Test DIF with mirt
# A test of non-uniform DIF
nonuniform_test_the <- DIF(
  MGmodel = model_the, # Use multi-group model above
  which.par = "a1", # Constrain slopes relative to a fully free model to test non-uniform DIF
  scheme = "add", # Specify that parameters in which.par will be constrained
  p.adjust = "none"
)

# A test of omnibus DIF
omnibus_test_the <- DIF(
  MGmodel = model_the, # Use multi-group model above
  which.par = c("a1", "d1", "d2", "d3"), # Constrain intercepts and slopes relative to a fully free model to test omnibus DIF
  scheme = "add", # Specify that parameters in which.par will be constrained
  p.adjust = "none"
)

# A test of uniform DIF (omnibus - non-uniform)
uniform_test_the <- left_join(
  omnibus_test_the %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2_omnibus = X2),
  nonuniform_test_the %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2_nonuniform = X2),
  by = "item"
) %>%
  mutate(
    X2_difference = X2_omnibus - X2_nonuniform,
    p = pchisq(X2_difference, df = 3, lower.tail = F)
  )

dif_test_table(
  list(
    Uniform = uniform_test_the %>% transmute(item, X2 = X2_difference, df = 3, p),
    `Non-uniform` = nonuniform_test_the %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2, df, p),
    Omnibus = omnibus_test_the %>% rownames_to_column("item") %>% select(item, X2, df, p)
  ),
  "DIF tests: " %+% scheme_labels[["the"]] %+% " (anchor items show no test)"
)


## Estimate effect sizes of each (non-anchor) item's DIF
effect_sizes_the <- empirical_ES(model_the, focal_items = 1:9) %>%
  rownames_to_column("item")

effect_size_table(effect_sizes_the, "DIF effect sizes: " %+% scheme_labels[["the"]])


## Build tibble of expected values given group, item, theta
expected_values_the <- map2(
  .x = item_group_combinations$item,
  .y = item_group_combinations$group,
  .f = ~ {
    
    item_.x_.y <- extract.item(extract.group(model_the, .y), .x) # Group first: works across mirt versions

    expected_values_.x_.y <- tibble(theta = seq(-5, 5, .01)) %>%
      mutate(
        item = .x,
        group = .y,
        ev = expected.item(item_.x_.y, theta)
      )
    
    return(expected_values_.x_.y)
    
  }
) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

# Magnitude and Impact

```{r dif-magnitude-impact}
## Latent means and SDs under each scheme (HMS only; NHANES is reference group so distributed 0, 1)
latent_means <- list(model_inv, model_emp, model_the) %>%
  set_names(scheme_labels) %>%
  imap(~ {
    hms <- coef(.x, simplify = T)$HMS
    tibble(
      model = .y,
      mean = hms$means[1],
      sd = sqrt(hms$cov[1, 1]) # cov is the latent variance
    )
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

latent_means %>%
  mutate(model = if_else(model == scheme_labels[["inv"]], "No Anchors (Fully Constrained Model)", model)) %>% # Mean comes from model_inv, not the released models
  format_table("HMS latent mean and SD by scheme (NHANES fixed at mean 0, SD 1)", col.names = c("Scheme", "Mean", "SD"))


## Scale-wide impact by scheme
impact <- list(
  list(ev = expected_values_inv, mod = model_inv),
  list(ev = expected_values_emp, mod = model_emp),
  list(ev = expected_values_the, mod = model_the)
) %>%
  set_names(scheme_labels) %>%
  imap(~ {
    
    # EAP theta for each HMS respondent
    theta_hat_hms <- fscores(extract.group(.x$mod, "HMS"), method = "EAP")[, 1]

    # TCC gap (HMS minus NHANES) on the theta grid
    tcc_gap <- .x$ev %>%
      group_by(theta, group) %>%
      summarize(total = sum(ev), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = total) %>%
      mutate(
        theta = round(theta, 2), # For join
        gap = HMS - NHANES
      )

    # Join to actual HMS respondents' thetas, then summarize
    impact_.y <- tibble(theta = round(theta_hat_hms, 2)) %>%
      left_join(tcc_gap, by = "theta") %>%
      summarize(
        scheme = .y,
        STDS = mean(gap),
        UTDS = mean(abs(gap))
      )
    
    return(impact_.y)
    
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()

impact %>%
  format_table(
    "Test-level DIF: HMS minus NHANES expected total score, averaged over HMS respondents", 
    col.names = c("Scheme", "STDS (signed)", "UTDS (unsigned)")
  )


## Plot test characteristic curves (TCCs)
stds_labels <- impact %>%
  transmute(
    scheme = factor(scheme, levels = scheme_labels),
    label = "STDS = " %+% sprintf("%+.2f", STDS)
  )

tcc <- list(expected_values_inv, expected_values_emp, expected_values_the) %>%
  set_names(scheme_labels) %>%
  imap(~ .x %>%
    filter(between(theta, -3, 4)) %>%
    group_by(theta, group) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(ev), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(scheme = .y)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    scheme = factor(scheme, levels = scheme_labels),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("NHANES", "HMS"))
  )

tcc_plot <- tcc %>%
  ggplot(aes(theta, total, color = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, color = "grey70", linewidth = .3, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(linewidth = .6) +
  geom_text(
    data = stds_labels,
    aes(x = -3, y = 27, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 7.5 / .pt, color = "grey35"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ scheme, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sample_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = expression("Depression (" * theta * ", NHANES SD units)"),
    limits = c(-3, 4),
    breaks = -3:4
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Expected PHQ-9 total score",
    limits = c(0, 27),
    breaks = seq(0, 27, 3)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Expected PHQ-9 Total Score by θ, Group, and Anchoring Scheme") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(14, "pt"))

tcc_plot

save_figure(tcc_plot, "Test Characteristic Curves by Group", height = 3.2)





## Individual-level DIF impact: naive vs DIF-adjusted theta (Crane et al.)
# Naive scores assume no DIF (from invariant model)
# Difference is salient if |difference| > median SE of naive scores
theta_naive <- fscores(model_inv, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = T)
salient_threshold <- median(theta_naive[, "SE_F1"])

individual_impact <- list(model_emp, model_the) %>%
  set_names(scheme_labels[c("emp", "the")]) %>%
  imap(~ tibble(
    scheme = .y,
    sample = df$sample_fct,
    theta_naive = theta_naive[, "F1"],
    theta_adjusted = fscores(.x, method = "EAP")[, "F1"]
  )) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(diff = theta_adjusted - theta_naive)

individual_impact_summary <- individual_impact %>%
  group_by(scheme, sample) %>%
  summarize(
    r = cor(theta_naive, theta_adjusted),
    mean_diff = mean(diff),
    sd_diff = sd(diff),
    max_abs_diff = max(abs(diff)),
    pct_salient = mean(abs(diff) > salient_threshold),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

individual_impact_summary %>%
  mutate(pct_salient = percent(pct_salient, .1)) %>%
  format_table(
    "Individual-level DIF impact: DIF-adjusted minus naive theta (salient if |difference| > " %+% sprintf("%.2f", salient_threshold) %+% ")",
    digits = 3,
    col.names = c("Scheme", "Sample", "r", "Mean difference", "SD of difference", "Max |difference|", "% salient")
  )


## Item-level DIF (SIDS) by scheme
sids_by_scheme <- list(effect_sizes_inv, effect_sizes_emp, effect_sizes_the) %>%
  set_names(scheme_labels) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "scheme") %>%
  mutate(
    anchor = case_when(
      scheme == scheme_labels[["emp"]] ~ item %in% c("phq_4", "phq_5"),
      scheme == scheme_labels[["the"]] ~ item %in% c("phq_1", "phq_2"),
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    scheme = factor(scheme, levels = scheme_labels),
    item = factor(item_labels[item], levels = rev(item_labels)) # So that item 1 is at the top
  )

sids_plot <- sids_by_scheme %>%
  ggplot(aes(item, SIDS, color = scheme, shape = anchor, group = fct_rev(scheme))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = SIDS), linewidth = .5, position = position_dodge(width = .5), show.legend = F) + # Line from zero to each dot
  geom_point(size = 2, fill = "white", position = position_dodge(width = .5)) + # Dodge < 1 so dots within an item sit closer than items do
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = scheme_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 21), # 21: hollow circle with white fill, so the zero line doesn't show through
    labels = c(`FALSE` = "Studied item", `TRUE` = "Anchor item")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "SIDS: HMS minus NHANES expected item score at the same theta (points, 0-3)") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(order = 1), shape = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  labs(title = "Item-Level DIF (SIDS) by Anchoring Scheme") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(legend.box = "vertical", legend.box.just = "left", legend.spacing.y = unit(2, "pt"), legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

sids_plot

save_figure(sids_plot, "SIDS by Scheme", height = 5)
```

# Depression Prevalence by Screening Methodology

```{r depression-prevalence}
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

## Screening definitions (each a 0/1 indicator)
df_screen <- df %>%
  mutate(
    phq_2_sum = phq_1 + phq_2,
    n_criteria = rowSums(across(phq_1:phq_9, ~ . >= 2)),
    screen_phq9 = as.numeric(phq_sum >= 10),
    screen_phq2 = as.numeric(phq_2_sum >= 3),
    screen_phq2_phq9 = as.numeric(phq_2_sum >= 3 & phq_sum >= 10),
    screen_algorithm = as.numeric(n_criteria >= 5 & (phq_1 >= 2 | phq_2 >= 2))
  )

screen_labels <- c(
  screen_phq9 = "PHQ-9 ≥ 10", # (1) sens = .86, spec = .85
  screen_phq2 = "PHQ-2 ≥ 3", # (2) sens = .72, spec = .85 vs semi-structured (Levis et al.)
  screen_phq2_phq9 = "PHQ-2 ≥ 3 and PHQ-9 ≥ 10", # (2) sens = .70, spec = .91 vs semi-structured (Levis et al.)
  screen_algorithm = "DSM-5 algorithm" # (1) (3) sens = .57, spec = .95 vs semi-structured (He et al.)
)

# (1) https://karger.com/pps/article/89/1/25/289799/The-Accuracy-of-the-Patient-Health-Questionnaire-9
# (2) https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/article-abstract/2766865
# (3) https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S0163834314002540


## Survey designs
# NHANES: build on all cycles, then subset to 2021-2023
nhanes_design <- svydesign(
  data = df_screen %>% filter(sample_fct == "NHANES"),
  ids = ~ psu, strata = ~ strata, weights = ~ weight, nest = TRUE
) %>%
  subset(most_recent_survey)

# HMS: clustered by school, nonresponse weights
hms_design <- svydesign(
  data = df_screen %>% filter(sample_fct == "HMS"),
  ids = ~ psu, weights = ~ weight
)


## Weighted prevalence (logit CIs) by screening definition and sample
designs <- list(NHANES = nhanes_design, HMS = hms_design)

prevalence <- expand_grid(
  sample = names(designs),
  screen = names(screen_labels)
) %>%
  mutate(
    est = map2(sample, screen, ~ svyciprop(as.formula("~" %+% .y), designs[[.x]], method = "logit")),
    prevalence = map_dbl(est, as.numeric),
    lower = map_dbl(est, ~ confint(.x)[1]),
    upper = map_dbl(est, ~ confint(.x)[2]),
    sample = factor(sample, levels = names(designs)),
    screen = factor(screen_labels[screen], levels = screen_labels)
  ) %>%
  select(-est)


## Table: prevalence (95% CI) by sample, plus HMS / NHANES ratio
prevalence_table <- prevalence %>%
  mutate(estimate = 
           percent(prevalence, .1) %+% 
           " (" %+% 
           percent(lower, .1) %+% 
           ", " %+% 
           percent(upper, .1) %+% 
           ")"
         ) %>%
  select(screen, sample, estimate, prevalence) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = c(estimate, prevalence)) %>%
  mutate(ratio = round(prevalence_HMS / prevalence_NHANES, 1)) %>%
  select(screen, NHANES = estimate_NHANES, HMS = estimate_HMS, ratio) %>%
  arrange(screen)

prevalence_table %>%
  format_table(
    "Weighted prevalence of a positive screen, % (95% CI); NHANES 2021-23, HMS 2025-26",
    col.names = c("Screening method", "NHANES", "HMS", "HMS / NHANES")
  )


## Plot: prevalence (95% CI) by screening method and sample, with HMS / NHANES ratio
prevalence_plot <- prevalence %>%
  ggplot(aes(prevalence, fct_rev(screen), color = sample)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), linewidth = .6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = prevalence_table,
    aes(x = .42, y = fct_rev(screen), label = "× " %+% sprintf("%.1f", ratio)),
    inherit.aes = F,
    hjust = 0, size = 8 / .pt
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = .42, y = length(screen_labels) + .5, label = "HMS ÷ NHANES",
    hjust = 0, size = 7.5 / .pt, color = "grey35"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = sample_colors,
    labels = c(NHANES = "NHANES 2021–23", HMS = "HMS 2025–26")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Weighted prevalence of a positive screen (95% CI)",
    labels = percent,
    limits = c(0, .47),
    breaks = seq(0, .4, .1)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(name = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Positive Screens by Screening Method and Sample") +
  theme_style() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = .3))

prevalence_plot

save_figure(prevalence_plot, "Prevalence by Screening Method", height = 3.2)
```
